title: Look Nice, but Product Info is Lacking
text:
Look Nice, but Product Info is Lacking. I love a good Moscow Mule and as most everyone will agree, this is one of those drinks that needs its own, specific serving vessel to enhance the experience. For Moscow Mules, that vessel is, of course, a copper mug and a good choice for this is the Artisans Village Moscow Mule Copper Mug.

Out of the package, these copper mugs look nice. They are not exceptionally fancy in design, but the copper and the brass handle look good. The handle has a flat piece at the top which is perfect for placing your thumb, for more secure control. And best of all, these mugs keep your drink cold for a LONG time! With ordinary glass or plastic, the beverage gets warm far too quickly, especially when you take your drinks outdoors on a hot day, like I often do. These metal mugs keep the beverage cold for the duration and you can really feel the coldness when you touch the beverage- filled mugs.

So far, so good, but there are some facts about these mugs that concern me. My greatest concern is the confusion over the metal composition. Read the fact sheet on this page and it says there is nickel on the inside, which is certainly not what I expected. I assumed it was lined with stainless steel, but then I read the fine print product description and found out it is made from nickel. However, the description you see here at the top of the page says it is stainless steel. Maybe it is both? They really need to clarify this because, if it truly is nickel, some people will not be able to drink from this mug. I’m a little concerned, too, because while I am not allergic, I certainly do not want to freely use these mugs at gatherings if they really are made from nickel. I don’t want to take that chance.

All things considered, these Moscow Mule mugs from Artisans Village do look nice and they do serve to enhance a beverage. They are made for Moscow Mules, but they can be used for anything you like. I wish there was more reliable info on these mugs, but they still have their usefulness and have enough going for them to recommend.
